issue: Preview error + 'Retry preview' (camera output keeps running) is not designed on any picture or dropdown
evidence: UI_REDESIGN §2/§4 PreviewErrorNotice + Retry preview; r3 only has diagnostics 'Preview: No preview error' row; grep 'Retry Preview' = none
scenario: Native preview renderer fails mid-meeting; picture freezes/black with no explanation, user assumes Zoom is broken
recommendation: Add a picture error state: orange badge with message, 'Retry Preview', caption 'Camera output continues'; mirror in dropdown preview area

issue: Starting state (Opening UltraStudio… / Connecting / Ready-before-first-frame) is missing; feeds jump from Stopped/Waiting to Live
evidence: FeedStateLabel Connecting/Ready/Waiting for HDMI (inventory §2.1); grep 'Connecting|Opening UltraStudio|Starting' across r3 = none
scenario: User presses Start and sees no feedback for ~1–2 s while the device opens
recommendation: Add 'Starting…' strip/picture state with spinner and the capture message; include in states matrix

issue: 'Applying change…' and selected-vs-applied pipeline states are lost; strips only show chips + switch + 'Effects active'
evidence: AppliedPipelineState (inventory §2.1: Effects selected / Complete bypass selected / Applying change… / active); grep 'Applying' = none
scenario: Mid-meeting the user toggles Downscale; output renegotiates (S3) but the UI shows the new chip as already active
recommendation: Show a transient 'Applying…' state on the strip and picture while format renegotiates; show 'selected' (outlined) chips while stopped

issue: LUT loading state is missing ('Loading LUT…', spinner, effects disabled, Start disabled until loaded)
evidence: LUTControls loading + canStartFeed requires !loading (inventory §2.9, §6.3); grep 'Loading LUT' in pages = none
scenario: At launch the saved LUT restores; Start looks enabled but does nothing
recommendation: Add loading row to ⋯ popover LUT section and a disabled Start with tooltip 'Waiting for the saved LUT'

issue: Camera-extension request pending / awaiting approval state is not designed (Install/Remove disabled while pending, status text, Open System Settings)
evidence: ExtensionInstaller.pending + status (inventory §2.3, §6.3); states only shows 'Camera not installed' and 'unsigned build'
scenario: First run: user clicks Install, macOS waits for approval; UI gives no 'waiting for approval' guidance
recommendation: Add pending state in sidebar Output, Settings Camera and onboarding: spinner, 'Approve Ultracam Camera in System Settings › General › Login Items & Extensions', 'Open System Settings' button; buttons disabled

issue: Expand tile / Restore layout and resizable Side by Side split are lost (only 'Swap Pictures' in the View menu)
evidence: MonitorWorkspaceShell Expand tile, Restore layout, draggable split 0.2–0.8 with accessibilityAdjustableAction (inventory §3.1); r3 columns fixed 1fr/1fr, no expand anywhere
scenario: User wants Feed 1 large for focus checking during a two-camera session without switching layout
recommendation: Add 'Expand Picture' to picture context menu/hover (and ⌥-double-click), plus a draggable divider in Side by Side; or justify removal in the index

issue: Anchor and Emphasis pickers are only reachable via the Program menu; removed from the main window and absent from Settings
evidence: Current MultiCameraControls shows Anchor/Emphasis; r3 grep: 'Anchor' only in app-menus.html
scenario: User sets up a two-camera talking-head session and can't find where to choose the anchor shot
recommendation: Add Anchor/Emphasis to the sidebar Output section under Strategy (shown when Natural talking head) or to Settings › Switcher

issue: Default recording folder has no Clear action
evidence: RecordingControls 'Clear' (inventory §2.6); settings Recording shows Change…/Finder only
scenario: User wants per-camera folders only and to remove the default
recommendation: Add Clear/None option to default folder row

issue: No control for FeedDescriptor.enabled (pre-existing gap), yet cuts/auto/start-all depend on enabled feeds
evidence: AppSettingsStore FeedDescriptor.enabled; AppModel startFeed iterates descriptors where enabled; no toggle in r3
scenario: User keeps a third camera configured but unplugged; Program start tries it / it appears in cut lists
recommendation: Add 'Enabled' (or 'Use in session') switch to ⋯ popover and sidebar row context menu; dim disabled feeds

issue: Audio gaps diagnostic missing from Diagnostics
evidence: README: diagnostics include audio gaps; diagnostics.html audio section lists packets/samples/drops only
scenario: Investigating A/V sync issues without the gap counter
recommendation: Add 'Audio gaps' row to Diagnostics › Embedded audio

issue: Minimum window size (980×680) is specified but never designed; expanded strips (nowrap rows needing ~520 pt) can't fit two ~340 pt columns, toolbar has ~6 groups
evidence: spec.html §1 'Minimum size: 980 × 680 pt (two 16:9 columns at about 340…)'; r3.css .strip3 .r white-space:nowrap; no page at min size
scenario: User narrows the window beside Zoom on a laptop; strips overflow/clip, toolbar items collide
recommendation: Define responsive rules: below ~1150 pt content width auto-collapse strips, stack sidebar to rail/hidden, move cut group into overflow; mock at min size

issue: 13" laptop / small-display fit not considered: default window 1320×860 (vs current 1080×700) exceeds 1280×800 'larger text' layouts and leaves no room beside Zoom
evidence: spec §1 default 1320×860; UltracamApp current defaultSize 1080×700
scenario: User on a MacBook in a Zoom call wants Ultracam beside the Zoom window
recommendation: Keep default ≤1080×700 or scale to screen; design a compact side-by-side-with-Zoom arrangement (sidebar hidden, collapsed strips)

issue: Long feed names: truncation rules undefined for picture pills, tally badges, toolbar cut buttons, sidebar rows, menu rows (paths are covered)
evidence: spec typography 'Paths truncate in the middle'; all mocks use 'Feed 1/Feed 2'
scenario: User renames cameras 'Interview A-cam (FX3)'; toolbar cut group and pills overflow
recommendation: Specify per-component max widths + tail truncation with full name in tooltip/VoiceOver; mock with a long name

issue: Full screen / external display monitoring not designed (only 'Enter Full Screen' menu item)
evidence: app-menus View 'Enter Full Screen fn F'; no full-screen layout
scenario: User puts the Ultracam window on a second display as a monitor during a shoot
recommendation: Design full-screen behavior: sidebar/strips auto-hide, toolbar reveals on hover, pictures maximize; or detached monitor to second display

issue: Light appearance covered by a single sample (one column + dropdown top + status bar)
evidence: spec §8 only
scenario: User runs macOS in Light; sidebar, popovers, menus, states, settings unverified
recommendation: Render main-expanded, menubar, settings in Light; check contrast of tally/chips/meters

issue: Sleep / lid close / display sleep during a meeting or recording is not designed (no prevent-sleep, no warning, no resume behavior)
evidence: No r3 page mentions sleep; capture/recording stop on system sleep
scenario: User closes laptop lid after the meeting while a backup take is finishing; take interrupted
recommendation: NEW: hold a power assertion while live/recording; status bar/menu note 'Keeping Mac awake while recording'; states for 'Recording interrupted by sleep' → Recover

issue: Capture device unplugged/replugged mid-session (device disappears) not distinguished from HDMI signal loss
evidence: states covers No HDMI signal and generic 'Recording stopped after a source error'; no device-missing state; inventory: Start unavailable when device missing
scenario: Thunderbolt cable bumped mid-take: device vanishes; user doesn't know whether to replug or check the camera
recommendation: Add 'UltraStudio disconnected' strip/picture/sidebar state with reconnect guidance and auto-resume on reappearance; take ends safely + Recover

issue: Consumer-driven automation edge cases undefined: Zoom's settings preview counts as camera use (README) so NEW 'Record with camera apps' would create takes just from opening Zoom video settings; Zoom switching to another camera mid-meeting stops output/auto-stop
evidence: README line 62 'Zoom's camera settings preview also counts as camera use'; sidebar/settings 'Record with camera apps' NEW
scenario: User opens Zoom › Settings › Video to check framing; a backup take starts and stops, littering the folder
recommendation: Add minimum-duration/confirm rule (e.g. start recording only after N s of continuous use, discard <10 s takes) and document switch-away behavior; show in states

issue: Consumer identity and multiple consumers: UI says 'In use by Zoom' but the extension only counts consumers (Int; property '1'/'0'), and two apps using one camera is undefined
evidence: CameraProvider.swift consumers += 1, property value consumers>0 ? '1':'0'; r3 sidebar/strip/status 'In use by Zoom'
scenario: Zoom and OBS both open Ultracam · Feed 1; UI claims Zoom (or can't name either)
recommendation: Use 'In use' / 'In use by 2 apps' unless identity becomes available (NEW runtime work); define multi-consumer display

issue: Changing Output mode changes the published camera name (Ultracam · Feed 1 ↔ Ultracam · Program); no guidance that Zoom must re-select the camera
evidence: VirtualCameraRegistryPublishing names per mode; settings Camera 'Change while stopped' only
scenario: User switches to Program before a meeting; Zoom still shows the old camera/black
recommendation: After a mode change show 'Select Ultracam · Program in Zoom' banner in sidebar Output and dropdown

issue: Responsive rules undefined
Dropdown length vs screen height
evidence: menubar.png at 1x: dropdowns a≈675 pt, b≈690 pt, c≈510 pt, d–g≈570–610 pt tall incl. preview; fits 956-pt (13" Air default) and 800-pt displays below a ~24–37 pt menu bar; NSMenu scrolls automatically if exceeded
recommendation: Keep row count ≤ ~22; with 3–4 feeds collapse Cameras into one submenu
